purpose: Test whether questioned preprocessing heuristics materially alter a fixed diagnostic learner under the corrected Route A v3 cohorts and disjoint evaluation settings.

known_before_freeze: The Route A v3 main predictions and participant-level statistics had been inspected.
The split, label-mapping, feature-definition, algorithm-reproducibility and baseline-fairness audits had been inspected.
No Route A v3 preprocessing-sensitivity result had been generated or inspected.
timing_and_scope.selection_prohibition: No sensitivity variant may replace the reference pipeline because it produces a higher result. This analysis is descriptive and post-hoc.
timing_and_scope.claim_scope: No superiority, non-inferiority, safety, causal or online-deployment claim.

data.excluded_columns: packet counter and every non-EEG auxiliary column
data.binary_label: raw levels 0-1 = class 0; raw levels 2-3 = class 1

shared_feature_pipeline.bandpass: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth, 0.5-55 Hz, applied to each complete recording before windowing

learner.fairness_rule: identical learner and hyperparameters for every preprocessing variant

recording_disjoint.repeat_policy: average repeated split results within participant; never treat seeds as independent samples

participant_disjoint_loso.scope: Arithmetic S01-S15 and Stroop S01-S13 separately

cross_task.scope: within each S01-S13 participant in both task directions
cross_task.target: three target recordings, raw levels 1-3; target natural recording excluded as an exact cross-task duplicate

outcomes_and_statistics.recording_probability: geometric mean of window probabilities followed by renormalization
outcomes_and_statistics.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt zero handling and approximate p value
outcomes_and_statistics.multiplicity: one Benjamini-Hochberg family across all 24 non-reference comparisons

reproducibility.resume_policy: variant-specific feature caches and completed variant fold checkpoints are reused only when their configuration digest matches
reproducibility.reference_parity: independently rebuilt reference features must match the corrected pure-eight-channel Route A features before evaluation
